title: 그림자 여권
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop rock ballad. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated eighth-note patterns with light chorus and delay. A baritone male vocal performs with breathy delivery in the lower register, transitioning to a powerful chest voice in the higher register. Bass guitar enters with sustained root notes. Drums feature a heavy snare with gated reverb and a consistent kick pattern. Distorted electric guitars enter during the crescendo with sustained power chords. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggio with chorus effect]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
이 적막이 나를 깨웠어
새벽 네 시 울컥 골목 [bass guitar enters with sustained notes]
아무도 없는 돌밭에
내 발소리만 울려
가로등 아래 그림자가 [drums enter with heavy snare]
혼자 나를 따라와
여기까지 왔는데 그림자는 한 곡뿐이야

[Chorus]
[distorted electric guitar power chords]
어디를 가도 나는 나야
